title: Caskade — Your games. Under one roof.
description: One game library for your whole home. Bring together store games, emulators and web games, with saves and playtime that follow you. Free and open source.
eyebrow: Your next game is already yours
intro: Every store. Every console. Every PC in your home. Bring your collection together in one library, one press from playing.
heroNote: Free and open source · No Caskade account · No telemetry
sourcesIntro: A home for the games you already own
featuresTitle: A collection, not a collection of launchers.
featuresIntro: From the game you bought yesterday to the one you grew up with. Give them all a place to live.
libraryBody: Caskade finds games across your launchers, stores and folders. Artwork, search and collections make a scattered library feel like your own.
householdBody: Pair your devices to keep your library, saves and playtime in step. Copy a game across your network, or stream it from the PC in the next room.
retroBody: Add your ROM folders or connect a RomM server. Caskade helps install and configure emulators, then puts your old favourites beside your new ones.
principlesTitle: Built around playing. And staying out of the way.
principlesIntro: Your collection lives on your device. You choose what gets installed, what gets shared and how it all looks.
offlineBody: Browse and launch local games without an internet connection. Paired devices can sync directly on your local network.
privacyBody: No Caskade account, telemetry or advertising. Store sign-ins stay in your operating system’s keychain.
customBody: Use themes and plugins to shape Caskade around your collection. Switch to console mode and settle in with a controller.
downloadEyebrow: Make room for your whole collection
downloadIntro: Caskade is in early development. Pick your platform and find the latest downloads on GitHub.
linuxBody: The platform where every feature is developed and tested. Built for desktop Linux, including gamescope.
windowsBody: Windows builds are available. Launching, streaming and sync have been tried in VMs; some hardware checks remain.
macBody: macOS bundles are available, but the desktop app has not yet been verified on a Mac. Expect rough edges.
macFormats: Apple silicon and Intel · Disk images
releaseNote: Choose the file for your platform on the release page.
faqAccountAnswer: No Caskade account is needed. Your library stays on your devices. You can connect existing store accounts to import games you own, including games you have not installed yet.
faqStores: Does this replace Steam or my other launchers?
faqStoresAnswer: Caskade brings your games together and starts them through the right launcher, emulator or program. Games that need a store launcher still use it. Caskade sells nothing and adds no DRM.
faqController: Can I use it from the couch?
faqControllerAnswer: Yes. Console mode has larger cards, controller navigation and an on-screen keyboard. It starts automatically under gamescope, or you can switch it on in settings.
faqContributeAnswer: Try a build, report a problem, translate a string, make a theme or contribute code. Caskade is open source under the MIT licence.
issuesLink: Find an issue to work on.
closingTitle: All your worlds. One place to play.
footerNote: Made for your games. Open to everyone.
